title: serde_json default float parser is not correctly rounded: 123456789.12345679 becomes 123456789.1234568
culprit: Cargo features of serde_json (no `float_roundtrip`) used by config_ini.rs ConfigValue::from_json
suggested_fix: enable serde_json's `float_roundtrip` feature (no new crate, so no `cargo update`)
